name: Safe Deploy
description: Full deploy pipeline with safety gates: review diff → run tests → safety check → merge → verify deploy → canary monitor. Prevents deploying broken code.
context_rules: Never force-push to main/master. Never skip tests in the deploy pipeline. Always verify production health after deploy. If any gate fails, BLOCK the deploy and report why.

steps.name: Pre-Flight Gate
steps.description: Run pre-flight review before touching anything. Architecture + security + scope check.
steps.instruction: Run the pre-flight-review skill on the current branch. Check: scope (no drift), architecture (data flow, error handling), security (injection, auth, data exposure). Only proceed if verdict is READY or CONDITIONAL with documented P1s.
steps.verification: Pre-flight verdict: READY or CONDITIONAL. 0 P0 issues.
steps.validation_prompt: Is pre-flight verdict READY or CONDITIONAL? Are there 0 P0 blocking issues?

steps.name: Run Test Suite
steps.description: Execute full test suite. All tests must pass. Coverage must not decrease.
steps.verification: All tests passing. No coverage decrease from base branch.

steps.name: Safety Gate — User Approval
steps.description: Final confirmation before deploy. GUARD mode active — destructive operations will be warned.
steps.instruction: Present deploy summary to user: what's being deployed, what tests passed, any remaining P1/P2 issues from pre-flight. Safety guard is active — destructive git operations will require confirmation. Ask: 'Deploy to production?' Options: A) Yes, deploy now, B) Wait, I need to check something, C) No, abort deploy.
steps.validation_prompt: Did the user explicitly approve deployment (option A)?
steps.routing_prompt: If user chose A (deploy), route to step 3. If user chose B (wait), wait and ask again. If user chose C (abort), end the workflow.

steps.name: Merge to Main
steps.description: Sync and merge with guardrails active
steps.instruction: git fetch origin main && git checkout main && git merge --ff-only <branch>

steps.name: Push and Deploy
steps.description: Push to origin and trigger deployment
steps.verification: Push successful. CI pipeline triggered successfully.

steps.name: Verify Deploy Health
steps.description: Check production is healthy after deploy. Run canary checks.
steps.instruction: Wait for CI to complete. Then verify production health: 1) Check production URL loads (no white screen), 2) Check console for errors (zero new errors), 3) Check performance (no regression >20%), 4) Check core flow still works. If any check fails, initiate rollback discussion.
steps.verification: Production URL loads. Zero new console errors. No performance regression >20%. Core flow works.
steps.validation_prompt: Does production load normally? Are there zero new console errors? Is performance stable? Does the core flow work?

steps.name: Canary Monitor (10 min)
steps.description: Monitor production for 10 minutes post-deploy. Check error rates and user impact.
steps.instruction: Set up a 10-minute monitoring window: 1) Watch error rates (alert if spike >2x baseline), 2) Watch performance metrics (alert if p95 latency >2x baseline), 3) Watch user reports. After 10 minutes: if all clear, report DEPLOY HEALTHY. If issues detected, escalate with severity and recommended action (rollback vs hotfix). Log deploy results to learnings-keeper for future deploy risk assessment.
steps.verification: 10-minute monitoring window completed. Zero alerts triggered or all alerts acknowledged and resolved.
steps.validation_prompt: Did the 10-minute monitoring window complete? Were zero alerts triggered, or were all alerts acknowledged and resolved?

variables.name: canary_duration_minutes
variables.description: How long to canary-monitor after deploy
